## What's free

Serverless: $100 credit for the first 30 days, no card; then pay-as-you-go; Kafka API compatible

> Free tiers change without notice. Check <https://www.redpanda.com/pricing> before relying on this.

## Notes

Clusters suspend when the credit or the 30 days run out. Data is deleted 7 days later unless a card is added.

## Plan

- `modules/<service>`: the managed resources, sized to the free tier by default
- `stack/`: the root module whose outputs expose connection details (sensitive values marked `sensitive`)
